full_prompt_en: A square photograph of a weathered wall centers a vertically oriented Japanese-style poster showing a teal whale above turbulent patterned water and large dark green leaves. The poster is smaller than the frame, leaving an irregular border of stained beige plaster visible on all sides. Its paper is cream colored with a double teal rule near the edges, and the entire printed surface is faded, mottled, and lightly scratched. Near the upper center, a large red circle sits inside a decorative arch. A few vertical columns of Japanese characters are printed over and beside the red shape, but their worn and small forms are not fully legible. Below them, cream-tipped teal waves fill the middle of the sheet, curling around the broad side of a whale that glides horizontally from left to right. The animal's rounded head, tiny eye, and pale underside are defined by restrained lines and flat color, while its tail reaches toward the right edge of the printed picture. In the lower portion, wide dark green lotus-like leaves overlap the water in a dense cluster. Two small rectangular panels of red and black writing sit near the lower corners; their individual characters remain too worn to transcribe reliably. A small dark strip at the very bottom closes the design inside its border. The wall behind the poster has patchy brown marks, abrasions, and rough areas that echo the aged print without becoming part of the illustration itself. Flat ambient light exposes the faded paper, print grain, and wall texture evenly, with only a slight shadow along the poster edge. The overall composition is orderly and nostalgic, setting a tightly framed teal, cream, red, and green graphic against a broad distressed plaster field.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形照片拍下有风化痕迹的墙面，中央贴着一张纵向日式海报：一条青蓝色鲸鱼位于翻涌的程式化水纹与宽大深绿叶片之间。海报比画幅小，四周露出不规则的污渍米色灰泥边框。纸面是奶油色，靠边有双道青蓝框线，整块印刷表面褪色、斑驳并带轻微刮痕。靠近上方中央，一枚大红圆置于装饰性拱形之内。几列竖排日文印在红形及其旁边，但磨旧而细小的笔画并不完全可辨。其下，奶油色浪尖的青蓝水纹填满纸面中部，环绕一条从左向右水平游过的宽阔鲸身。动物圆头、小眼睛与浅色腹部由克制线条和平色界定，尾巴伸向印刷图面的右边。下方，宽大的深绿、近似荷叶的叶片在水前紧密叠压。左下和右下附近各有一小块红黑文字框，单字磨损太多，无法可靠誊写。最下边一条窄深带在边框内收束设计。海报后的墙面有斑片棕色印迹、擦伤与粗糙区域，与旧印刷互相呼应，却不属于插画本身。平缓环境光均匀显出褪色纸张、印刷颗粒和墙面肌理，海报边缘只有轻微阴影。整体构图有序而怀旧，把被紧密框起的青蓝、奶油、红与绿色图形放在宽阔的旧灰泥场域前。
style_prompt_en: The vintage print treatment uses a strict rectangular frame, flat limited color, and intricately repeating ornamental linework. Muted teal and deep green occupy broad cool areas, set against aged cream paper and one concentrated vermilion accent. Curving bands and clustered organic shapes form dense interior movement, while surrounding margins and ruled borders restore order. Fine ink lines, imperfect registration, faded pigment, and tiny scratches make the surface look physically printed rather than digitally pristine. Textlike vertical marks can act as graphic rhythm, but remain subordinate to the large color structure unless genuinely legible. Ambient light is even, allowing paper wear and walllike texture to provide depth in place of modeled shadows. The overall effect is decorative, restrained, and nostalgic, with formal balance softened by age and abrasion.
style_prompt_zh: 这种复古印刷处理使用严格的矩形框架、有限平色和细密重复的装饰线纹。低饱和青蓝与深绿占据宽阔冷色区域，对照旧奶油色纸面和一块集中的朱红强调。弯曲色带与成团的有机形体构成内部密集运动，周围留边和框线又恢复秩序。细墨线、轻微套印不准、褪色颜料与细小刮痕让表面像真实印刷，而非数字式完美。竖向近似文字的笔痕可以构成图形节奏，但除非确实可读，否则仍从属于大色结构。环境光均匀，以纸张磨损和墙面般肌理代替塑形阴影提供纵深。整体效果装饰、克制而怀旧，正式平衡被岁月与磨蚀柔化。
theme_en: A weathered Japanese-style poster of a teal whale amid stylized waves and lotus leaves
theme_zh: 一张旧化日式海报描绘青蓝色鲸鱼，周围是程式化海浪和荷叶
name: Japanese vintage poster
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
